item.title: CVE-2026-136853 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraDashboardAction#getMostFailingStages, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

item.title: CVE-2026-136854 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | Jenkins Rich Text Publisher Plugin 1.5 and earlier does not escape job names in error messages rendered by the Rich Text Portlet, resulting in a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exploitable by attackers with View/Configure permission.

item.title: CVE-2026-62151 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | mysql_fdw builds string literals for queries sent to the remote MySQL server with an escaping routine that is not character-set aware. When the connection uses a multi-byte character set such as GBK, SJIS or Big5 and MySQL's default backslash escaping is in effect, a crafted value whose trailing byte is 0x5C absorbs the escaping backslash and leaves the following quote unescaped. The routine handles every pushed-down string constant, including ordinary WHERE-clause literals, so an authenticated user with only SELECT on a foreign table can break out of the literal and run arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server with the credentials of the user mapping. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw forces NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES into the session sql_mode and escapes string literals by doubling single quotes.

item.title: CVE-2026-62152 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | mysql_fdw accepts several security-sensitive connection options from roles that are not superusers. A role with USAGE on the mysql_fdw foreign data wrapper can set init_command, which runs arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server at every connection, including connections made with other users' mappings on a shared foreign server. The same role can set mysql_default_file, ssl_key, ssl_cert, ssl_ca and ssl_capath, which name files read from the PostgreSQL server host, allowing server-side file reads and connection redirection. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, only superusers can set init_command, mysql_default_file, ssl_key, ssl_cert, ssl_ca and ssl_capath.

item.title: CVE-2026-62153 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.4
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.4 | mysql_fdw inserts several values into statements sent to the remote MySQL server without escaping them: the dbname and table_name options in ANALYZE, the remote schema name and the LIMIT TO and EXCEPT table names in IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, and the sql_mode option in the SET sql_mode command. A user who can create or alter foreign tables or foreign servers, or run IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, can break out of the string literal and run arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server with the credentials of the user mapping. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw escapes these names and accepts only letters, digits, underscores and commas in sql_mode.

item.title: CVE-2026-62154 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.5 | During IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, mysql_fdw copies column metadata returned by the remote MySQL server into the CREATE FOREIGN TABLE statements it runs locally without quoting it. The COLUMN_DEFAULT value is placed directly in the DEFAULT clause, and the name of the generated ENUM type is inserted unquoted. A malicious or compromised MySQL server, or an attacker who can tamper with the connection, can return crafted information_schema metadata and run arbitrary SQL in the local PostgreSQL session of the user who runs IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw quotes these values before building the statements.

item.title: CVE-2026-62155 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | mongo_fdw builds the mongodb:// connection URI by inserting option values without percent-encoding them, so URI metacharacters (@ : / ? # & =) in a value are parsed as part of the URI structure. A role that is not a superuser but has USAGE on a foreign server can set the username and password options in its own user mapping. An @ or other metacharacter in those values can point the connection at a host the attacker controls, allowing connection redirection, credential capture and man-in-the-middle attacks. Server-level options such as the address, database and replica set can be injected the same way. The issue is fixed in mongo_fdw 5.6.0. From mongo_fdw 5.6.0, mongo_fdw builds the URI with the libmongoc URI API, which encodes credentials, and rejects URI metacharacters in the other option values.

item.title: CVE-2026-62156 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.5 | hdfs_fdw builds string literals for IN and = ANY(array) clauses pushed down to the remote Hive or Spark server without escaping single quotes. An authenticated user with only SELECT on a foreign table can supply a crafted array value that breaks out of the literal and changes the HiveQL query, which then runs on the remote server with the foreign server's credentials. The same release fixes two lower-severity issues: the JDBC connection string, including the trustStorePassword value, was written to logs, and credentials stayed in memory in cleartext after the connection was established. The issue is fixed in hdfs_fdw 2.4.0. From hdfs_fdw 2.4.0, hdfs_fdw escapes single quotes in these literals, masks trustStorePassword in logs and clears credentials from memory after connecting.

item.title: CVE-2026-62157 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | mongo_fdw converts _id values to 12-byte MongoDB ObjectIds with libbson functions that read a fixed number of bytes without checking the input length: 12 bytes for a bytea _id, and 24 characters for name-typed values and $oid fields in JSON. A shorter value causes a read past the end of the input, which can crash the PostgreSQL backend or include adjacent memory in the query sent to MongoDB. Any user who can supply an _id value or predicate on a foreign table can trigger it. The issue is fixed in mongo_fdw 5.6.0. From mongo_fdw 5.6.0, mongo_fdw accepts only valid 24-character hexadecimal ObjectIds and 12-byte bytea values.

item.title: CVE-2026-73517 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a command injection vulnerability in the terminal v1alpha2 file download endpoint where the path query parameter is inserted via fmt.Sprintf into sh -c tar commands executed inside the target container, and the DownloadFile handler fails to perform its own pods/exec authorization check. Attackers with only pod get permission, including built-in read-only project-viewer, workspace-viewer and cluster-viewer roles, can supply shell metacharacters in the path parameter to execute arbitrary commands inside any viewable container without holding pod exec permission.

item.title: CVE-2026-110470 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | Stack-based buffer overflow in the mkevent helper in Checkmk <2.5.0p21, <2.4.0p42 and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows an attacker who controls the check output of a monitored host to crash mkevent, causing the notification to be lost, or to redirect the notification to an IPv4 address of their choice, if notifications are forwarded to the Event Console.

item.title: CVE-2026-135135 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Mongoid builds an incomplete automatic encryption schema for certain embedded document associations. As a result, values that the application declared as encrypted may be written to the database in cleartext, with no error or warning returned to the application. A party holding only basic read privileges on the affected collection, and no access to the encryption keys, may then obtain those values in readable form.

item.title: CVE-2026-135138 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Mongoid does not consistently apply its read-only attribute protection when attribute names are supplied dynamically by the caller. In an application that forwards caller-supplied attribute names into a document update, a user with basic application privileges may change values held inside a field the model declared immutable. This may result in unintended modification of data the application treats as trusted, such as flags used for its own access decisions.

item.title: CVE-2026-135139 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Mongoid contains an incorrect authorization weakness in the handling of caller-supplied filters for bulk removal through a referenced association. Conditions already attached to the association can take precedence over the filter the caller supplied, so records the caller did not select may be removed. A user with basic privileges in an application built on the library may cause unintended removal of records belonging to the same parent record.

item.title: CVE-2026-135140 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Mongoid may omit a field from the client-side encryption settings it generates for a collection when that same field is also used as a reference to another record. The value is then stored in readable form instead of encrypted, and the application receives no indication that this has happened. A party with ordinary authenticated read access to the affected collection may be able to view data that was intended to be protected.

item.title: CVE-2026-135141 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | A logic flaw in the query-building layer of the Mongoid object-document mapper causes a model-level default restriction that is meant to return no records to be silently discarded when it is combined into a query. A user with basic application privileges who sends an ordinary request may read, change, or remove records that the restriction was intended to withhold.

item.title: CVE-2026-135146 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.1 | An improper certificate revocation check in the MongoDB Python Driver's optional TLS revocation-checking support allows an unauthenticated party that operates the network endpoint a client connects to, and that holds a revoked but still-dated certificate trusted by that client, to have the connection accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of application credentials and other session data, and in the client treating responses from that endpoint as genuine.

item.title: CVE-2026-135225 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | An information exposure weakness in the connection string handling of the MongoDB Ruby Driver can place credential material from the application's own configuration into the text of a parsing error, where an existing redaction control does not apply. A party able to read the application's error output or logs may thereby obtain database credential text together with deployment coordinates. The condition arises entirely within the embedding application process and requires no database authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-135226 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component of BSON for Ruby allows a party who can supply parser input to influence how a serialized document is framed. Content placed in one value may be read back as additional or replacement document fields. An unauthenticated party supplying input to an application that parses untrusted Extended JSON and stores the result may cause unintended modification of stored data.

item.title: CVE-2026-135227 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association handling allows structured input supplied in place of a simple identifier value to be turned into an object that is treated as an already-stored record of a caller-chosen model class. In applications that pass unfiltered request data into the affected association handling, an unauthenticated party may cause unintended modification or removal of stored records, and may render an individual record unreadable through that association.

item.title: CVE-2026-135898 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8 | An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension of the MongoDB Python Driver may allow an unauthenticated party who can supply crafted BSON data to the decoder to cause the application process to terminate. In some configurations, nearby process memory may be included in error messages, which may result in limited unintended disclosure of data.

item.title: CVE-2026-136697 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | A flaw has been found in LibrePhotos up to 1.2.1. Affected by this issue is the function write_metadata of the file apps/backend/api/metadata/writer.py of the component ExifTool Metadata Write-Back. This manipulation of the argument person_name causes argument injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.3.0 can resolve this issue. Patch name: f83dafca9f1a6dd0441b7e4d5c13992896a7d76f. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

item.title: CVE-2026-136721 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was determined in coleifer peewee up to 4.5.3. This affects the function _print_table of the file pwiz.py of the component File Import Handler. This manipulation causes code injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The reported GitHub issue was closed with the reason "completed". However, it was not possible to determine the PR or commit which could have fixed this issue.

item.title: CVE-2026-136722 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A vulnerability was identified in Zhengzhou Weiwei Information Technology mayicms up to 5.8E. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file member.php. Such manipulation of the argument code leads to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-81405 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the Comm.ReceivePacket function of the NSE rpc.lua library, which buffers ONC-RPC record fragments using the server-declared fragment length without an upper bound. A malicious RPC service on a scanned host can declare fragments of up to roughly 2.1GB, and up to 400 fragments per call, causing the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the read path is reached by rpcinfo.nse during version detection (-sV) and is shared by the NFS, rusers and NetWorker scripts.

item.title: CVE-2026-81406 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the read_db2_packet function of the db2-das-info.nse script, which trusts an unmasked 32-bit length field supplied by the server. A malicious DB2 Administration Server on a scanned host can declare a packet length of up to roughly 4.29GB, causing the script to buffer that much data and the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the script runs during version detection (-sV).

item.title: CVE-2026-81407 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Nmap before 7.992 contains a hardcoded cryptographic key vulnerability in the DHCAST128 login of the NSE afp.lua library, which uses a fixed, publicly known Diffie-Hellman private exponent. A passive observer of the network traffic between Nmap and an Apple Filing Protocol server can compute the shared secret from the hardcoded exponent and the server's public value and decrypt the password supplied to scripts such as afp-showmount.nse and afp-brute.nse through the afp.username and afp.password arguments, without man-in-the-middle access or cryptanalysis.

item.title: CVE-2026-81408 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Nmap before 7.992 contains a loop with an unreachable exit condition in the parameter-list parsing of the NSE drda.lua library, which keeps growing its parameter list while processing a malicious DRDA response. A malicious DRDA service on a scanned host can make the loop consume memory without bound on 64-bit builds, exhausting the Nmap process and discarding NSE results for every other host in the same scan batch without reporting an error; the library is reached by service probes during version detection (-sV).

item.title: CVE-2026-81409 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the http-cisco-anyconnect.nse script and the anyconnect.lua library, whose redirect handler follows a server-supplied redirect target without checking that it stays on the scanned host. A malicious web server on a scanned host can redirect Nmap to an arbitrary host and port, including internal and loopback addresses the attacker cannot reach directly, making Nmap send a HEAD request followed by a POST request there; response content is not returned to the attacker. The script runs in the default script category (-sC, -A).

item.title: CVE-2026-81410 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the broadcast-upnp-info.nse script and the upnp.lua library, which fetch the device description from the LOCATION URL in a UPnP response without checking that it points to the responding host. An attacker on the local network who answers the script's discovery broadcast can supply a LOCATION URL for an arbitrary host, port and path, including internal and loopback addresses, making Nmap send a GET request there; response content is not returned to the attacker.

item.title: CVE-2026-81411 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the ConfCreateResponse GCC block parser of the NSE rdp.lua library, which does not check that each block advances the read position. A malicious RDP server on a scanned host can include a single malformed zero-length block in an otherwise valid handshake, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process that the script-timeout option does not interrupt; the library is used by rdp-enum-encryption.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

item.title: CVE-2026-81412 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in the unmarshall_array function of the NSE msrpctypes.lua library, which trusts the entry count declared by the server. A malicious SMB server on a scanned host can declare an EntriesRead value of 0xFFFFFFFF with an empty buffer, causing a prolonged CPU spin and exhausting the memory of the Nmap process; the library is used by smb-enum-shares.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

item.title: CVE-2026-81413 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the inline AXFR response reader of the dns-zone-transfer.nse script, which reads the zone transfer response without a size limit. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data over TCP port 53 after the AXFR request, causing the memory of the Nmap process to grow at the attacker's send rate until it is exhausted.

item.title: CVE-2026-81414 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the sendPacketsTCP function of the NSE dns.lua library, which reads a DNS-over-TCP response without a size limit and builds it by repeated string concatenation. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data in response to the initial SOA lookup made by dns-zone-transfer.nse, before any AXFR request is sent, causing unbounded memory growth and quadratic CPU cost in the Nmap process.

item.title: CVE-2026-81415 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the negotiate_tn3270 function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose device-type search loop does not advance when the server sends a protocol-conformant DEVICETYPE IS response without an LU suffix. A TN3270E server on a scanned host, including a non-malicious one that sends such a response, causes a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

item.title: CVE-2026-81416 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the process_write function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose write loop does not advance when it processes a malformed Repeat to Address (RA) order. A malicious TN3270 server on a scanned host can embed a single 6-byte malformed RA order in an ordinary screen-write data stream after a normal negotiation, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

item.title: CVE-2026-81417 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the dispatcher of the NSE tftp.lua library, which removes completed coroutines but not ones that ended in an error, leaving a zero-yield spin. A malicious TFTP exchange reached by snmp-ios-config.nse after an SNMP write sequence can leave a dead coroutine that freezes the entire Nmap invocation, before port scanning begins for any target in the run; the hang is prevented when the script-timeout option is set.

item.title: CVE-2026-81418 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.9
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.9 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the TLV.AUTH parser of the NSE eigrp.lua library, whose length arithmetic cancels out the running read position. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single crafted EIGRP Update of roughly 36 bytes over unauthenticated multicast, causing unbounded table growth that exhausts the memory of the Nmap process when broadcast-eigrp-discovery.nse is running.

item.title: CVE-2026-81419 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.9
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.9 | Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the LSUpdate.parse function of the NSE ospf.lua library, which does not advance when it reads an LSA header with a zero length. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single spoofed, unauthenticated OSPF LS Update packet, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process as soon as broadcast-ospf2-discover.nse captures it.
